template/tree#

The syntax tree of a section template: literals, variables, sections, inverted sections and partials.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

for TemplateTree("{{#items}}{{name}}{{/items}}").nodes() -> node { node.kind(); }

Description#

The syntax tree of a section template: literals, variables, sections, inverted sections and partials. SectionTemplate uses it.

By default at most 1 Mi characters of source, 20000 tokens and sections nested 64 deep.

object TemplateTreeNode#

object TemplateTreeNode

Domain grammar nodes, not application reflection. text() is exact literal text or a trimmed name/path. Only section/inverted nodes can contain children. Child arrays are immutable; leaf children are the meaningful empty sequence.
